_comment: Sample Vapi end-of-call-report payload for smoke-testing Template 01. Synthetic data based on the Vapi server-events documentation as of 2026-05. The Vapi schema places transcript/messages/recording under message.artifact.* and the summary under message.analysis.summary - NOT at the message root. Source: https://docs.vapi.ai/server-url/events and https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/call-analysis. POST this body to your test-webhook URL with Content-Type: application/json. To exercise the HMAC verify path, also send the matching x-vapi-signature header (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, hex-encoded, signed with VAPI_SIGNING_SECRET).

artifact.transcript:
User: Hi, I called yesterday about a tour booking for next weekend. Did you save my preferences?
Assistant: Yes, I have your details. You asked about the Tramuntana hike for two people on Saturday morning. Would you like to confirm?
User: Yes please, lock it in for Saturday at 9am.
Assistant: Done. I'll send the confirmation to the email you gave me last time. Anything else?
User: That's all, thanks.
